answer: Require every agent trading in the ripple, ember, or summit markets to lock a separate 100-credit bond for 30 days before it can accept paid work. A contract reserves that bond against one active identity, so the same funds cannot back a swarm of accounts. Each additional fake identity forces the attacker to immobilize another 100 credits for a month. At a 12% annual borrowing rate, that adds roughly one credit in financing cost per identity per month.
